name: device-pnp-mismatch
description: gf180mcu vertical (substrate) PNP local mismatch: an identical pnp_05p00x05p00 pair and the area-ratioed pnp_05p00x05p00/pnp_10p00x10p00 pair, each at 1 uA and 10 uA. This manifest lets sim/run_corners.py run the same fragment as a generic representative check (one un-reproducible, single-draw sample of each pair's dVBE, --list/--check-env discovery); the authoritative evidence record -- N=300, seeded Monte Carlo mean/sigma/3-sigma per pair, at three temperatures -- is produced by run_pnp_mismatch.py, which drives sim/harness's library (pdk.py, runner.py, report.py, corners.py) directly because a `dowhile`/`reset` Monte Carlo loop does not fit a single tb.json op-point grid.
claim: gf180mcu vertical (substrate) PNP local mismatch for the Brokaw core selected in DR-0001 (spec/decision-records/0001-bandgap-topology-selection.md). See run_pnp_mismatch.py's records/ output for the full N=300 seeded distribution; this manifest's own generic-CLI run reports one un-reproducible sample only, with no statistical claim.
subset_reason: No supply rail: every DUT is a diode-connected device referred to its own emitter node at ground and driven by an ideal current source, so the +/-10% supply axis has nothing to sweep -- see the 'nosupply' corner-id production in sim/README.md. Process is `bjt_typical` only: local mismatch is intra-die variation, deliberately decoupled from the global BJT process-corner axis already recorded in device-pnp-vbe (see run_pnp_mismatch.py's own subset justification). run_pnp_mismatch.py's own records/ output uses the 'nosupply' convention directly (corner-ids like bjt_typical_-40c_nosupply); this generic-CLI run collapses the supply axis to nominal instead, since sim/run_corners.py's grid always carries a vdd_val, and reports one un-seeded op-point sample rather than the N=300 seeded distribution -- see 'claim' above.

da1.description: loose wiring sanity bound on the unseeded single-draw dVBE for the identical pair (run_pnp_mismatch.py's seeded N=300 record reports sigma ~0.04-0.05 mV here); +/-1 mV is a wide margin and should never flake

da10.description: loose wiring sanity bound on the unseeded single-draw dVBE for the identical pair (run_pnp_mismatch.py's seeded N=300 record reports sigma ~0.04-0.05 mV here); +/-1 mV is a wide margin and should never flake

dr1.description: loose wiring sanity bound on the unseeded single-draw dVBE for the area-ratioed pair. This pair's dVBE is dominated by the deterministic emitter-area ratio (~25.5-44.7 mV across -40..125 C in run_pnp_mismatch.py's seeded N=300 record), not by mismatch, so the bound is asymmetric and centered on that range rather than on zero -- min_spread_pct is not used because this generic-CLI run's three temperatures are independent unseeded draws
